episodes.synopsis: A chance encounter with a stranger introduces Ko to a nocturnal life. Ko follows her and why shouldn’t he? The night is still young.
episodes.title: 1st Night: First Flight

episodes.synopsis: How can you fall in love with a vampire when you can’t even track them down!? Nazuma remains frustratingly elusive, but Ko may have a nostalgic solution to this new problem.
episodes.title: 2nd Night: Do You Do LINE?

episodes.synopsis: When can you start calling someone a friend? What even IS friendship, anyway? As Ko reconnects with a classmate, questions arise he isn’t sure he knows how to answer.
episodes.title: 3rd Night: A Lot Came Out

episodes.synopsis: Three’s a crowd when Ko invites Akira to hang out with him and Nazuna late one evening.
episodes.title: 4th Night: Isn't This a Tight Squeeze?

episodes.synopsis: How does Nazuna make money, anyway? Ko is about to get the inside scoop on her (very suspicious) business, but first he’ll need to make sense of his complicated emotions.
episodes.title: 5h Night: Well, That’s a Problem

episodes.synopsis: Ko doesn’t need a mirror to see his reflection. It’s staring right back at him in the form of Nazuna’s latest client.
episodes.title: 6th Night: Might as Well Have Fun

episodes.synopsis: Boredom drove Ko into the night. Boredom drove Ko’s new acquaintance to killing time in her own way. She and Ko seem very similar… perhaps TOO similar for comfort.
episodes.title: 7th Night: Reproduce

episodes.synopsis: Ko thought he had all the time in the world, but the revelation of an unexpected deadline changes everything. Hopefully his friends (new and old alike) will have some advice.
episodes.title: 8th Night: All of Us

episodes.synopsis: Seri is extremely popular, but popularity isn’t all it’s cracked up to be when one of her human paramours develops feelings she isn’t ready to deal with.
episodes.title: 9th Night: No Fair

episodes.synopsis: It’s not all sparkles and hearts at the maid café where Midori works. Someone is creeping on a certain maid, but uncovering the interloper isn’t as easy as it looks…
episodes.title: 10th Night: Enlarge the Peeping-Tom Photos

episodes.synopsis: Nazuna needs new blood for her cuddle-buddy business, and Ko is on the case! But he’s not the only one wandering the night looking for someone…
episodes.title: 11th Night: Do You Know What a Vampire Is?

episodes.synopsis: What does it mean to be a vampire? Why does Ko want to become one? A chat with a friend reveals Ko’s lack of answers to these all-important questions.
episodes.title: 12th Night: My Mom’s Out Tonight

episodes.synopsis: The night feels distant. Ko isn’t sure how to close that gap.
episodes.title: 13th Night: Call of the Night
